title: Move SOA item search and attachment extraction to GPT-5.5 deployments
summary: Sales Order Agent AI operations move to GPT-5.5 chat deployments for attachment extraction, item search expansion, and item selection while leaving other SOA AI calls on GPT-4.1.
key_points: Attachment extraction, broader item search and item selection now use GPT-5.5 chat deployments
Relevance checks, mail template validation and signature handling stay on GPT-4.1 latest
Attachment extraction can still send file parts because GPT-5.5 chat preview is already on the multimodal allow-list
Prompts, schemas, temperature, max tokens and JSON mode are unchanged; only the deployment is swapped
quote: Moves three Sales Order Agent AI calls to the GPT-5.5 chat deployments
